notes.content:
Here is the list of bug fixes and improvements made:
[list]

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: The Halloween 2022 Pupdate
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Howloween![/h1]
Today we're thrilled to release the MASSIVE expansion pupdate that we've been working on for about a year. A lot of the feedback we've received sounds something like, "This is pretty fun, I just wish there was [i]more[/i]..." After talking through all our ideas for additional content, we decided to add... well, basically everything! Here's a few highlights of the expansion:

[h2]New Quests:[/h2]
With the addition of new costume-specific quests, we've more than DOUBLED the number of quests in the adventure!

[h2]New Locations:[/h2]
With new things to do, you'll need new places to see! The map is roughly triple the size of the original design with even more candy to find.

[h2]New Characters:[/h2]
And of course Halloween is nothing without a whole host of creepy characters. Introduce yourself to over 10 new characters that all hate Principal Lester as much as the kids.

[h2]And much more:[/h2]
New & improved cutscenes, enhanced sound effects, additional dialogue, and bug fixes are just the tip of the gummy corn for this massive expansion.

Our tiny team here has put all our candy on the table for this one and we really hope you enjoy the new Howloween Hero. We've had an absolute blast working on this game and hope it brings an extra smile to your Halloween.

notes.title: Mac OSX support and Major Patch 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we're thrilled to be releasing the Mac version of Howloween Hero along with a number of big quality of life improvements and additional languages. Here's a list of some of the highlights we're putting into this first major patch!

1) Some temporarily BAD localization added for French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, and Spanish.
	a) We WILL be working on making these translations better, but we wanted to ensure that all of the infrastructure was built to support full localization. If you or anyone you know is interested helping with any translations, please let us know in the discussion boards!
2) New Title screen, no longer a video, but a 3D environment with your dog onscreen in their costume. (Note, this only works with a new save file, so if coming from an old version, the dog will be naked until going into the game)
3) Sprinting added
4) Characters turn their heads to look at LilPup
5) Bug fixes when giving items, and items spawning after being used.
6) More dynamic environment pieces (eyes and doors).
7) Refactored Pause Screen. No longer to include quests or How To Play screen.
8) Added Collections Screen. This includes quests, collected badges, as well as collected costumes.
9) Controller Vibration
10) Optimizations of LODS, Culling, materials, and textures.
11) Resolution, full screen, and quality settings added.
12) Dialogue updates.
13) Trick or treat characters no longer pause in the middle of their animations as they are talking to you.
